deployments_dispatch_state_check.name: deployments_dispatch_state_check
deployments_dispatch_state_check.value: ("deployments"."origin" = 'sitesync_initiated') = ("deployments"."dispatch_state" IS NOT NULL) AND ("deployments"."dispatch_state" IS NULL OR "deployments"."dispatch_state" IN ('pending','dispatched','dispatch_failed','confirming','confirmed_success','confirmed_failure','timed_out'))

deployments_confirmation_source_check.name: deployments_confirmation_source_check
deployments_confirmation_source_check.value: ("deployments"."confirmation_source" IS NULL OR "deployments"."confirmation_source" = 'provider') AND ("deployments"."origin" <> 'manual_record' OR "deployments"."confirmation_source" IS NULL)

hosting_links_provider_project_key.name: hosting_links_provider_project_key
hosting_links_provider_project_key.where: "hosting_links"."archived_at" IS NULL AND "hosting_links"."integration_id" IS NOT NULL

hosting_links_provider_project_required.name: hosting_links_provider_project_required
hosting_links_provider_project_required.value: "hosting_links"."integration_id" IS NULL OR "hosting_links"."provider_project_id" IS NOT NULL

production_approvals_target_required.name: production_approvals_target_required
production_approvals_target_required.value: "production_approvals"."action" = 'build_from_ref' OR ("production_approvals"."target_provider_deployment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "production_approvals"."target_deployment_id" IS NOT NULL)

projects_dates_order.name: projects_dates_order
projects_dates_order.value: "projects"."target_launch_date" IS NULL OR "projects"."start_date" IS NULL OR "projects"."target_launch_date" >= "projects"."start_date"

stage_history_reason_required.name: stage_history_reason_required
stage_history_reason_required.value: "stage_history"."transition" NOT IN ('skip_forward','move_back','hold','archive','restore') OR "stage_history"."reason" IS NOT NULL
